name: M5Stack Cardputer

display.notes: 240x135 landscape (rotation 1). ST7789V2 variant/CGRAM offset/pins differ from es3c28p host (needs-runtime-host).

touch_input.keyboard: 56-key matrix via 74HC138 select GPIO 8,9,11 and 7 input GPIO 13,15,3,4,5,6,7
touch_input.notes: No capacitive touch (hasTouch=false). Matrix keyboard not modeled (needs-runtime-host).

storage.sd: SD SPI (separate HSPI in code), MISO39 MOSI14 SCLK40 CS12
storage.sd_emulation: conditional(version/tool): esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd (ESP32-S3 SDMMC); board wiring not verified
storage.notes: SD SPI wiring not verified on esp-emu 1.1.0 (--sd is the S3 SDMMC path).

local.notes: No dedicated local emu env in repo docs.

pins.ir: present on hardware (variant dependent, uncertain pin details in prep extract)

notes: Flash/PSRAM sizing follows m5stack-stamps3 PlatformIO board def; verify with pio envdump when building locally. esp-emu may need matching --psram-size if firmware expects PSRAM.
UI possible only after host parameterization for 240x135/ST7789V2/CGRAM.
Primary input is keyboard matrix (no touch).
